name: Window
tagline: ravyn's window: the camera is a window that changes shape — full face, stack, bubble — on warm paper with one blue.

motion.direction: ravyn `window`. The camera is a window: FULL FACE → STACK (`card` mode with the element above the window) → BUBBLE (`pip`) → ELEMENTS ONLY (`arch`) — the window move IS the transition (0.5 s, small overshoot), never the same mode more than 4 scenes in a row; open and close on FULL FACE. Captions Inter 800, every word, 2 lines max, one Instrument Serif italic emphasis word in blue `ter`; mono labels in JetBrains Mono. Screenshots push 1.00 → 1.10. Light paper, ink type, one blue, nothing else.
